decisions.reason: The margin analysis extends the firm's core market-data offer with its own page, and nothing signals a shortfall against aspirations in a growing industry, so there is no trigger for problemistic search.
The gas tariff comparison sits close to the core business and runs on the maintained databases at low marginal cost, so organisational slack easily carries it.
The regional electricity tariff calculator is core-adjacent and fits the central platform strategy; with Product D already consolidated, it likely absorbs that demand and meets aspirations.
The area definition tool complements the location-based products and the platform, so its value lies in supporting the rest of the portfolio rather than in standalone results.

The site-specific comparison line has low web visibility and some overlap with the other tariff tools, but it uses existing data at little cost, so slack in a growing market justifies keeping it for now.
